existing_rate_scope: Ontario ministry 2020-2021 Grade 9 entry cohorts for Toronto DSB and Toronto CDSB; no denominator counts in existing file

new_method_evidence.document: Student Achievement and Well-Being Committee, 15 October 2024
new_method_evidence.locator: PDF page 18 (printed page 11), Appendix B; also PDF page 10 (printed page 3)
new_method_evidence.finding: The ministry calculation follows the original Grade 9 board, including outcomes after moves to another Ontario board. Entry is restricted to ages 13-15 and first Ontario secondary enrollment. Deaths and departures from Ontario are removed. This is a provincial-method description from a different board, not Toronto cohort counts.
new_method_evidence.implication: Do not equate the Toronto entry-board estimand with graduation-school or current-resident city estimands. Denominator-weighted pooling still requires matching entry-cohort counts; ordinary enrollment or Grade 12 counts are not replacements.
new_method_evidence.version_limit: Describes the ministry method in October 2024; no later method-change verification was obtained.

additional_sources_checked.evidence: Official rendered page lists research/census, assessment, financial and safety data; this bounded check did not yield graduation cohort counts.
Official catalogue describes rates and progress indicators. Existing downloaded workbook supplies the board rates, but no cohort denominators.
Official indexed enrolment planning report uses secondary ADE and intake counts, not a matching graduation-cohort denominator; not downloaded or used as weights.

decision: No weighted Toronto-wide graduation rate added. Preserve existing restricted two-English-board rate envelope and missing coverage for French boards, private schools and resident/entry-board mapping.
